verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents a Usage API that reads real-time concurrency usage for the authenticated account, so an engineer can inspect their own account's concurrency. The pack never states the concurrency cap for each pricing tier or the cost to raise it. missing for 10: documented per-tier max concurrent requests/sessions, explicit confirmation that the Usage API returns the concurrency limit (not just usage), pricing or upgrade cost to raise the concurrency cap, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap

citations.quote: Read real-time credit and concurrency usage for the authenticated ScrapingBee account.
